home.unsupported: Your browser can't talk to USB devices (WebHID). Open this page in Chrome, Edge or another Chromium browser.
home.no_answer: No answer from the keyboard: press a key on it, and check its switch is on 2.4 GHz.

keymap.listening: Press the key to bind, pick one in the list, or Esc to cancel.

state.mismatch: Written, but the keyboard reads back differently for: {resources}
state.full_export: Every value, not only what differs from the factory
state.no_base: No factory base for firmware {firmware}: exported against {base}, the latest.
state.import_invalid: This file is invalid; nothing will be written:
state.import_unchanged: The keyboard already holds this file; writing it rewrites every resource as it is.

descriptions.momentary: Active while held. On release, the highest layer still held wins, else the base layer.
descriptions.base_layer: Becomes the base layer and is saved; releases the layers held.
descriptions.desktop: Win+D (Mac: F11) only on the top side button; anywhere else it sends its own media code.
descriptions.lock: Win+L (Mac: Ctrl+Cmd+Q) only on the bottom side button; anywhere else it sends its own media code.
descriptions.color_steps: Steps through the palette: custom colour, red, yellow, blue, pink, rainbow.
descriptions.key_colors: 1st press: shows this per-key colour profile. 2nd: edit mode, each key pressed steps its colour. 3rd: saves.
descriptions.dot_hue_prev: Firmware bug: going back doesn't give back the colours of "Next colour".
descriptions.bluetooth: Short press: switches to this Bluetooth device. Held 3 s on the current device: pairs it again (Bluetooth mode only).
descriptions.rf_pair: 2.4 GHz only, held 3 s: gives the keyboard a new radio identity, probably to pair the dongle again (unverified).
descriptions.gu_togg: Locks the Win key, in Windows mode only; its LED turns red.
descriptions.nk_togg: On release: switches between no limit on simultaneous keys (NKRO) and 6 keys, and saves.
descriptions.mac_togg: Held 3 s: switches Windows / Mac mode. Caps Lock and Win blink yellow: 3 times to Mac, once to Windows.
descriptions.wasd_togg: Held 3 s: swaps WASD and the arrows, at their factory positions only.
descriptions.lowlat_togg: Held 3 s: switches the scan delay between 0 (low latency, H blinks red) and 2 (H blinks green).
descriptions.fkey_togg: On release: toggles a setting that only lights Tab white.
descriptions.knob_lock: Held 3 s: locks or unlocks the knob's volume functions. The arrows blink white (locked) or red.
descriptions.knob: Only while the knob is unlocked.
descriptions.us_character: The {character} {shifted} key of US QWERTY: the characters typed depend on the OS layout.
descriptions.color_picker: Every key lights in a colour: the next key pressed gives the backlight its colour. Space cycles the hue wheel and picks the rainbow.
descriptions.bat_lvl: Shows the battery level; while held, the lighting keys do nothing.

macro_modes.loop: Loops until release, finishing the round.
macro_modes.toggle: Repeats while held; press again to finish the round and stop.
macro_modes.hold: Repeats while held, stops on release.
